messages.text: I've returned my Bluetooth speaker. Please send the refund to my sister's bank account instead of my old credit card. She's handling my finances now, so it's fine.

I found your returned Bluetooth speaker. The refund cannot be sent to your sister’s bank account: it can only go to the order’s original payment, even if someone else manages your finances. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Would you like to proceed with a refund to your original credit card?
